### Fixed
- **model-manager reaches the Hugging Face Hub for a kserve backend cluster-manager registers at runtime** (giantswarm/agent-platform#494): the hub egress of its network policy rendered only for a static `modelManager.backends` kserve entry; with `components.cluster-manager` on it renders as well — on gazelle `check_fit` hung on the hub lookup until muster's deadline.
- **The models Gateway's data plane passes the fleet's admission policies and gets its DNS record** (giantswarm/agent-platform#492): the Gateway references a models-specific `AgentgatewayParameters` (the platform's `gateway.parameters.podSecurityContext` / `containerSecurityContext` — seccomp `RuntimeDefault`, non-root, no capabilities —, `dataPlaneResources`, `agentgateway.proxy.image`, `modelServing.modelsGateway.replicas`, a LoadBalancer Service); on gazelle the controller's default Deployment was denied by `restrict-seccomp-strict` and the Gateway never programmed. Its infrastructure annotations carry `modelServing.modelsGateway.externalDns.annotations` (default `giantswarm.io/external-dns: managed`, the filter Giant Swarm's external-dns selects Services by) next to the hostname, so `models.<domain>` is created instead of falling through to the wildcard edge.
